description: Service split for the sumologic provider. `overrides` maps each vendor OpenAPI tag (normalized as provider-utils split does: lowercase, hyphens/spaces/dots to underscores) to a StackQL service name; tags that share a name are merged into one service document. Every tag in the spec must have an entry - bin/split.mjs fails on an unmapped tag. `descriptions` supplies the service description carried into provider.yaml (SHOW SERVICES). The collectors service is not tag-derived: it comes from the hand-authored Collector Management API spec in provider-dev/downloaded/sumologic-collector-management-api.yaml.

descriptions.access_keys: Access keys of the calling user and of the organization, their scopes, CORS headers and secret rotation.
descriptions.account: Account status, owner, subdomain, plan update requests, usage reports and usage forecasts.
descriptions.apps: The Sumo Logic app catalog (v1 and v2) - browse, install, upgrade, uninstall apps and follow the asynchronous install jobs.
descriptions.archive: Archive ingestion jobs that replay archived logs from an AWS S3 archive source.
descriptions.budgets: Data volume and search cost budgets and their usage.
descriptions.collectors: Collectors, Sources and Collector upgrades (the Collector Management API).
descriptions.connections: Webhook, ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other outbound connections used by monitors and scheduled searches.
descriptions.content: The content library - folders (personal, global, admin recommended, installed apps), content permissions, paths, and the asynchronous export, import, copy, move and delete jobs.
descriptions.content_sync: Multi-account content synchronisation jobs between child organizations.
descriptions.dashboards: Dashboards (New), dashboard report schedules, report generation jobs and legacy report migration.
descriptions.data_archiving: Data archiving destinations (AWS S3 buckets for archived logs).
descriptions.data_deletion_rules: Data deletion rules that remove already-ingested log data.
descriptions.data_masking_rules: Data masking rules applied at ingest.
descriptions.dynamic_parsing_rules: Dynamic parsing rules that extract fields automatically from JSON logs.
descriptions.event_extraction_rules: Event extraction rules (Event Analytics) and their quota.
descriptions.extraction_rules: Field extraction rules and their quota.
descriptions.fields: Custom fields, built-in fields, dropped fields and the field quota.
descriptions.health_events: Health events for collectors, sources, ingest budgets and other resources.
descriptions.ingest_budgets: Ingest budgets (v2) and their usage reset.
descriptions.log_searches: Saved and scheduled log searches, and estimated usage of a log search across data tiers.
descriptions.logs_data_forwarding: Log data forwarding destinations (AWS S3) and forwarding rules per partition.
descriptions.lookup_tables: Lookup tables, their rows, file uploads and the asynchronous lookup jobs.
descriptions.monitors: Monitors and monitor folders in the monitors library - search, path, copy, move, import, export, permissions, playbooks and usage.
descriptions.muting_schedules: Muting schedules in the muting schedules library.
descriptions.parsers: Custom and system parsers in the parsers library.
descriptions.partitions: Partitions (indexes), their retention and decommissioning, and the partition quota.
descriptions.policies: Organization security and behaviour policies - audit, search audit, data access level, data deletion, session limits, dashboard sharing, timestamp format, OAuth CIMD and access key lifetime.
descriptions.roles: Roles (v1 and v2) and role assignment to users.
descriptions.saml: SAML identity providers, allowlisted users and SAML lockdown.
descriptions.schemas: Schema identities grouped by product (Schema Base Management).
descriptions.search_jobs: Search jobs (v2) - create a log search job, poll its status and page through its messages and records.
descriptions.service_accounts: Service accounts and their access keys.
descriptions.service_allowlist: The service allowlist of CIDR addresses for login and content access.
descriptions.slos: SLOs and SLO folders in the SLO library, service level indicators and usage.
descriptions.source_templates: Source templates for OpenTelemetry collectors (v1 deprecated and v2).
descriptions.threat_intel: Threat intelligence datastore, data sources, retention and indicator ingestion.
descriptions.tracing: Traces, spans, trace and span queries, tracing metrics and the service map.
descriptions.users: Users and their lifecycle actions - unlock, password reset, email change, welcome email, MFA.
